codex.root_final_source: From output.app_server_events select entries whose runtime_generation equals output.runtime_generation, message.method is rawResponseItem/completed, message.params.threadId equals output.thread_id, message.params.turnId equals output.turn_id, item.type is message, item.role is assistant, and item.phase is final_answer. Require exactly one such item; join its content parts of type output_text in order.
root_final_exclusions: different turnId including earlier root turns
codex.owner_business_input_source: From each formal child thread's own commandExecution items (message.method item/completed, item.type commandExecution) read the plaintext business object the owner actually consumed: email_pack, choices and choices_scope. The recorded command may embed that object as JSON or as a Python literal inside shell quoting; both supported forms are decoded from the same command text. Require exactly one attributable object per formal child.
owner_business_input_exclusions: child task input delivered as item.type agent_message with an input_text NEW_TASK shell plus encrypted_content, which carries no plaintext business object
items of other threads or other runtime generations
codex.owner_business_input_fallback: A plaintext child user message (rawResponseItem/completed, item.type message, item.role user) remains the delivery fallback for hosts that hand the business object to the child itself; it is used only when the child's own commandExecution items expose no business object, and it keeps the frozen BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY reason code completed_user_payload_unobservable when it is absent or not unique.
codex.choices_scope_equivalence: The supported choices_scope value is the mapping professor_dir -> email ids. The object form and the list of {professor_dir, email_ids} entries describe the same value, so the comparison is on the parsed mapping; serialization form, key order and whitespace are never a failure. Every professor_dir string and every email id must match the caller's canonical value exactly.
codex.terminal_precedence: A proven FAIL_PRODUCT is never downgraded to a blocked or invalid terminal by another formal child's missing or ambiguous evidence.
codex.formal_ownership: Use the shared adapter @16 formal topology only. Identity diagnostics cannot create, rewrite, upgrade or downgrade ownership.
